items.name: Storm Kite
items.motif: a broad triangular electro-glass kite creature with translucent violet wing membranes, graceful gold ribs and white-cyan lightning veins

prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve / precise-object-edit. Reference shows two enemy spacecraft. Extract and REDRAW ONLY the broad triangular LEFT ship, Storm Kite as ONE standalone high-resolution transparent sprite. Do not include any part of the other ship.
Character: Storm Kite, a broad triangular electro-glass kite creature with translucent violet wing membranes, graceful gold ribs and white-cyan lightning veins. Preserve this exact new design, silhouette, materials, violet/gold/cyan palette and polished illustration style, with crisp clean native-resolution detail.
Square2048x2048 or largest available, minimum1024x1024. Center the complete single vessel on the square canvas, filling78% of its width/height as appropriate with at least10% transparent padding around every point, wing and antenna. Absolutely no clipping. All tips fully visible. High quality smooth surfaces, coherent lighting, restrained glow. Genuine alpha transparency outside vessel and inside gaps, main body opaque. No other objects, no background, no text, labels, borders, frames, humans, noise, grain, blur or rainbowfringe.
